title: Joop Barrow
body:
Description


The Joop Barrow is a faster and cheaper version of the Joop Grand Barrow but cannot hold as much storage. It is also a more expensive version of Rusty Joop Barrow, the starter vehicle.

Its speed tops out at 75 studs/s,


Trivia

  • Before v1.52.0 price was $1,520
  • In v1.52.0 price was $3,004
